blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: PEI grades climb from I (walls) to V (highways). For residential kitchens, Grade III is the "safe bet." For commercial malls, Grade IV or V. If you see "polished marble in a wet room," flag it as a BP 344 slip-resistance violation unless textured.</Tip>
